purpose: Design document defining the abstraction of the four forge wrapper SKILLs (query/update for rules and specs) that delegate document search and index updates to external backends: skill list, arguments, output contract, SKILL contract.
summary: Overview: forge delegates document search and index updating to doc-link or doc-db backends via four wrapper SKILLs
Scope: this design owns the SKILL abstraction; backend selection and per-backend routes belong to another design
Skill list: query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules, update-db-specs, each with a fixed category and user-invocable true
Query flow: resolve backend order, run the first available backend, never maintain the index, no grep fallback, explicit error when none is available
Query output contract: a Required documents path list built by a script, common across backends
Query SKILL contract: inheriting-type SKILL without context fork, restricted allowed-tools, args limited to keywords and a short task description
Update flow: an explicit backend option bypasses selection and errors if unavailable; otherwise ordered selection then route-specific update
Desired state: .doc_structure.yaml is authoritative, and paths not in the target set are removed from the index
Prerequisite: at least one backend must be available, judged by required capability rather than version
Test design: unit tests, lint checks, AI-Linter checks for dispatcher and worker roles, and wrapper transparency tests
tasks: Designing or modifying the query-db-rules and query-db-specs SKILLs
Designing or modifying the update-db-rules and update-db-specs SKILLs
Changing the output contract of document search results
Writing or reviewing SKILL.md for inheriting-type search SKILLs
Delegating index maintenance from query to update SKILLs
Adding or changing tests and lint for query wrapper wiring
Calling forge document search from other SKILLs
Reviewing design consistency with the backend selection design
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
